excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content:
Not super sure about how it looks:
https://github.com/tbenr/consensus-specs/commit/0154de00250fe69782ffca79626f1c851fa9d545

How clients are comfortable in switching the type at a particular fork? some clients may end up having a 7732 version of that method anyway...

Maybe one of these two options might be better:

1- (unified) have a brand new `beacon_blocks_and_payload_by_range/1/`  using a container.
  -PRO: nice and clean with new type
  -CON: we need to handle version transition (pre 7732 you have to use one method and than switch to new rpc)

2- (separated) having a dedicated `payload_by_range/1/` rpc and do the two call.
  -PRO: nice and clean with new types. Node could download data in parallel from 2 peers and might go faster.
  -CON: more complex syncing logic to orchestrate the two calls (but we already do it for blobs)

